name: Asset Entities / Strive
email_summary: TD Cowen hikes ASST price target to $44 on faster BTC accumulation; no new dilution or governance red flags this window.
bottom_line: The only new development this window is a sell-side price target increase reinforcing the accumulation-driven bull case already priced into recent 8-Ks; no new financing, dilution, or governance issues emerged beyond items already reported.
source_conflicts: Intraday ASST price quotes on 2026-09-22 varied slightly across sources ($29.68 on Robinhood vs. $29.97 on Investing.com vs. $29.66 on Yahoo real-time), likely reflecting different snapshot times rather than a data conflict.

mNAV figures (1.25x basic / 1.68x diluted per bitcointreasuries.net) are dated Sep 14, 2026 and predate the latest 1,355 BTC purchase and subsequent share price rally, so current mNAV is likely different and should be treated as stale.

updates.headline: TD Cowen raises ASST price target to $44 from $32
updates.what_happened: TD Cowen analysts Lance Vitanza and Jonnathan Navarrete lifted their price target on ASST, citing bitcoin accumulation that has outpaced their model and stronger growth in bitcoin held per fully diluted share. The firm now projects Strive will end 2026 with 32,105 BTC (up from a prior 27,156 estimate) and raised its full-year BTC Yield forecast from 54.1% to 70.1%.
updates.thesis_fit: A raised sell-side target grounded in accelerating BTC-per-share growth supports the thesis that Strive can build a durable, market-trusted Bitcoin-per-share story.

updates.headline: Strive CEO discusses bitcoin outlook on Bloomberg Crypto
updates.what_happened: Strive Chairman/CEO Matt Cole appeared on Bloomberg Crypto to discuss the broader digital-asset market, which had reclaimed roughly $3 trillion in value amid a bitcoin rally, alongside growing use of leveraged perpetual futures by traders. The segment was general market commentary rather than a company-specific disclosure.
updates.thesis_fit: Routine media commentary from management with no new treasury, financing, or governance information; does not change the thesis.
